business.headline: Showroom insurance or no car? What buyers can do if dealers refuse deliveryWhen buying a new car or bike, motor insurance is mandatory, but you may not have to buy it from the showroom. Here's what the rules say about choosing your insurer and what you can do if a dealer refuses delivery.

PM Modi's big business challenge: Indian bank in global top 5From the Red Fort, Prime Minister Narendra Modi set global scale targets for Indian banks and pharma companies. The push links India's next growth phase to building globally competitive firms across sectors.

He linked chipmaking, manufacturing growth and energy security to the push for a self-reliant and developed India.

Rs 55 to Rs 18,000: How minimum basic pay evolved before the 8th Pay CommissionAs government employees wait for the 8th Pay Commission, the big question is how much their salaries could rise. But before looking ahead, here's how basic pay has changed over the decades.

How can India scale up manufacturing? NITI Aayog picks 12 sectors to lead wayNITI Aayog has identified 12 sectors that could help India scale up manufacturing by 2047. The report says stronger supply chains, domestic components and private investment will be critical.

Reliance, Rolls-Royce join hands to develop engine for India's AMCA fighter jetThe proposed partnership will bring together Rolls-Royce's expertise in advanced aircraft engines and Reliance Industries' manufacturing, technology and execution capabilities.

Are FDs, gold, property losing their edge? Here's what Indians are exploring nextFor decades, Indian investors largely stuck to stocks, FDs, gold and property to build wealth. But as portfolios evolve, a new set of assets is starting to attract attention. Have a look.

Sensex, Nifty end lower as crude prices, Middle East uncertainty weigh on sentimentThe BSE Sensex closed at 78,009.25, down 70.71 points or 0.09%, while the Nifty 50 settled at 24,366, lower by 29.85 points or 0.12%. The Sensex had touched an intraday low of 77,684.37, while the Nifty fell to 24,296.80 during the session.

Is NCR closing the gap with Mumbai in the billionaire race?The spread of companies across both established and emerging business centres also suggests that India's wealth creation story is no longer limited to a handful of traditional commercial hubs.

DDA clears Delhi Master Plan 2047 with focus on housing, metro and green pushThe Delhi Development Authority has approved the Master Plan for Delhi-2047 and sent it on for final clearance. The proposal maps changes in housing, transport, construction approvals, green infrastructure and land use across the capital.

Tata Sons may pick internal candidate to replace N Chandrasekaran: ReportTata Sons has begun the search for N Chandrasekaran's successor, with internal names under discussion. The process is stalled for now because restrictions on the Sir Ratan Tata Trust are holding up the selection committee.

EPFO deadline: What happens if employers miss the August 15 ECR filing deadline?In its latest notice, EPFO reminded employers to file the July wage month ECR and deposit the applicable contributions by August 15.

Why US called Pune, Gujarat and Chennai 'ugly sister cities' in China trade reportThe White House's 'Great Transshipment Scam' report pairs India's Pune-Gujarat-Chennai manufacturing belt with Cincinnati-Dayton-Columbus in the US, as Washington steps up its crackdown on Chinese goods allegedly routed through third countries to avoid tariffs.

Svatantra Microfin files Rs 3,000 crore IPO papers with SebiSvatantra Microfin has filed draft papers with Sebi for a Rs 3,000 crore IPO comprising a fresh issue and an offer for sale. The proceeds are meant to bolster its capital base as existing investors partially pare their holdings.

Shiprocket IPO closes today: What are the estimated profits if you subscribe?The IPO opened for subscription on August 12 and closes today. The allotment is expected to be finalised on August 17, while the shares are scheduled to list on the NSE and BSE on August 19.

Vedanta Power, Adani, RIL: Why India's power giants are turning to nuclearVedanta Power, Adani, Tata Power and Reliance are positioning for India's nuclear push. Their interest reflects rising power demand, policy changes and the search for firm clean energy.

Tata Sons succession gets tangled in SRTT legal dispute. What's the issue?Tata Sons has begun the process to choose a new chairman, but the Sir Ratan Tata Trust cannot join key decisions because of a restraining order. The restriction has stalled joint trust nominations for the selection committee and could affect the upcoming AGM.

entertainment.headline: Ranveer Singh begins shooting for Jai Mehta's Pralay in Mumbai Actor Ranveer Singh has started shooting for action thriller Pralay in Mumbai. The move keeps the production rooted in real locations after a shift from Australia.

Batwara 1947 box office Day 2: Sunny Deol film sees big jump amid Awarapan 2 clash Actor Sunny Deol's Batwara 1947 posed a sharp Day 2 jump at the box office on Saturday. The growth lifted its worldwide gross to Rs 26.41 crore amid strong competition.

Kareena Kapoor shares Saif-approved holiday photos to wish him on birthday Actor Kareena Kapoor Khan wished Saif Ali Khan on his 56th birthday with candid family holiday pictures and a playful note. Saif also received special wishes from Akshay Kumar.

Sunny Deol reveals why he says no to pan masala, gutkha endorsements Actor Sunny Deol said on a podcast that he refuses pan masala and gutkha endorsements despite receiving offers. His remarks come as Maharashtra's FDA scrutinises a Vimal Elaichi advertisement over surrogate promotion.

Awarapan 2 box office Day 2: Emraan's film stays ahead, nears Rs 80 crore globally Emraan Hashmi's Awarapan 2 posed a strong Day 2 jump and stayed ahead of Batwara 1947 at the box office. The Saturday rise strengthened its Independence Day weekend run.

Rajinikanth marks 51 years in cinema with cake-cutting on Dharman sets. Video Rajinikanth completed 51 years in cinema on August 15. The milestone was celebrated on the sets of Dharman. Rajinikanth joined director Ashwath Marimuthu and the cast and crew for a special cake-cutting ceremony.

Pregnant Deepika Padukone makes rare appearance, Ranveer drops her at airport. Video Deepika Padukone was seen at Mumbai airport while Ranveer Singh dropped her off from their car. The sighting has renewed interest in the actor-couple's second pregnancy.

Anil Kapoor, Jackie Shroff were not paid for 1942 A Love Story: Vidhu Vinod Chopra Filmmaker Vidhu Vinod Chopra revealed actors Anil Kapoor and Jackie Shroff were not paid for 1942: A Love Story. Anurag Kashyap, Shubhra discuss age gap, marriage, how he almost pushed her away Filmmaker Anurag Kashyap and his girlfriend Shubhra Shetty spoke about their relationship, age gap and marriage in a joint interview. Pavan Malhotra's big praise for Yami Gautam, Kartik Aaryan, Sanjay Mishra Pavan Malhotra praised Yami Gautam, Kartik Aaryan and Sanjay Mishra for performances that impressed him. The actor said such work pushes actors to sharpen their craft and avoid repeating themselves.

Saif Ali Khan celebrates I-Day with Indian Army in Uri, visits Kaman Aman Setu Photos of Saif Ali Khan's recent visit to Kaman Aman Setu in Uri surfaced on Independence Day, showing him interacting with soldiers stationed there.
Hopefully soon: Emraan Hashmi drops big hint on Awarapan 3 Actor Emraan Hashmi met fans at a Mumbai screening of Awarapan 2 and hinted that Awarapan 3 could arrive very soon.

Inside Bollywood's pap economy: Who calls them, how they earn and what celebs hide India Today Digital spoke with Mumbai paparazzi to unpack how Bollywood sightings are planned, chased and sold. general news.headline: Air India Express passenger's gun goes off at Varanasi airport, two staffers shotAn Air India Express passenger's pistol went off during a weapons check at Varanasi airport on Sunday, injuring two staffers: a woman and man. The bullet first hit the ground before striking the staffers, who were taken to a private hospital.

The Communists played a dubious role, Gandhi was missing, and Gopal Patha emerged into fame and infamy. But the day, coming a year before Partition, was also a warning. A warning India failed to heed.
